name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 69 2026

venue.name: Pauley Ballroom
venue.address: Martin Luther King Jr Student Union ASUC, Berkeley, CA 94704, USA
venue.details: 3rd floor of the Martin Luther King Jr Student Union

information:
This competition is organized with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/).
- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents our 69th and final Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! Don't worry!  There will be more cubing in the bay area, but we will be retiring the name.
-  *If we run ahead of schedule, we will wait until the proper time to start the next time slot.*
- Competitors will be able to select their timeslots/groups and register for unofficial events [here](https://sixstringcal.github.io/BASC-69-Schedule/) before the event; however, we will be assigning timeslots to competitors who don't pre-select their timeslots.  These will be available on the competitor cards the day of as well as through [CompetitionGroups.com](https://www.competitiongroups.com/competitions/BayAreaSpeedcubin692026) approximately a week before the competition.

### The Grand Finale: Celebrating 13 years of Bay Area Speedcubin'
The 69th and final installment of Bay Area Speedcubin', featuring unofficial events, games, panels, and good ol'-fashioned speedcubin'!
